serviceAssertion.description: 调用方服务用部署时登记的Ed25519私钥签发≤60秒断言（iss=调用服务、aud=本服务、method、path、bodyHash、jti）；接收方按trustAnchorRef服务公钥表验证并拒绝重放

userDelegation.name: X-Portal-Proof
userDelegation.description: portal为当前请求签发的≤10秒用户委托证明（actor、grants、sessionVersion、route、bodyHash）；下游链路原样传递，接收方仍经identity:checkAuthorization核权限与会话版本

visitorSession.name: nw_visitor
visitorSession.description: traffic-guard签署的伪名访客会话；只用于公开问答与语言偏好，不含IP

admissionPermit.name: X-Admission-Permit
admissionPermit.description: portal为公开AI请求向traffic-guard申请的准入许可；问答服务消费，网关本地验签

sessionCookie.name: nw_sid
sessionCookie.description: identity签发的HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict会话；只由portal读取

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: 写操作必需；portal经identity核对会话绑定
